title: OSHA Form 300A, summary of work-related injuries and illnesses, 2025

must.line: kind: record, or report if the vocabulary has one; never policy. The vocabulary has no "report".
agency includes OSHA or Oregon OSHA, the same label string cases 06 and 09 produced for this company
subject includes something like "injury and illness recordkeeping", "OSHA 300" or "recordkeeping"
Status (must): current, recorded or no_gaps_found. Never "compliant".
Gaps (must): none. The form is complete and certified. Any gap on it is a false finding and fails the run.
Facts (must contain, quote verified true): annual average number of employees 65, as_of 2025-12-31 or 2025
Consistency across the three runs: the agency label must be the same string in all three.

must_not.line: a gap about the number of cases; a statement that 3 injuries is high or low
subject: case
injur
recordable
incident rate
dart

must_not.line: a claim about the emergency plan (the scan cannot see it). expected_missing is not counted — it is the honest "companies like this usually also hold" channel (the note on case 06a).
subject: emergency action plan
emergency plan
evacuation plan

reported.line: doc_date kind "signed", "issued" or "certified"; any passes. The vocabulary carries issued|revised|last_entry|effective|unknown.
Deadlines (may contain, correct if present): posting period February 1 to April 30, 2026, passed; next summary to be posted February 1, 2027 (recurring). Neither is required of the scan.
May contain: 3 recordable injuries in 2025; 1 case with days away; NAICS 424690; total hours 128,400.
